verses.1: And Peter and John also went up to the temple at the hour of prayer.
verses.2: And then there was a strange man who lived in the womb of his mother. Every day, he would stand near the door of the temple, at the place called “Horaia”, where people could plead for forgiveness from those who went to the temple.
verses.3: He, who saw that Peter and John were about to enter the temple, asked for forgiveness for his sins.
verses.4: And when Peter saw him, he said to him, along with John, “Look at us.”
verses.5: And he kept them there, expecting to get something from them in return.
verses.6: Peter said, “I do not have silver or gold. But what I do have, I give to you. This is the name of Jesus Christ, the Nazarene.”
verses.7: And when he took him by the right hand, he raised him up. But his bones and muscles became stiff and inflexible.
verses.8: And he stood in confusion and trembling. He entered the temple with them, walking around, and worshiping the god.
verses.9: And all the people saw him as he walked around and praised the god.
verses.10: We realized that this man was the one who sat in authority at the altar of the temple, on the rock. The people were filled with fear and dismay upon hearing this.
verses.11: After he had kept Peter and John there, all the people gathered around them on the hill called Solomon’s Hill.
verses.12: When Peter saw this, he replied to the people: “Men of Israel, why do you wonder at this? Or why do you consider it an act of special power or piety on our part that we can walk on the water like that?”
verses.13: The God Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, our ancestors’ God, honored His son Jesus. You yourselves, however, rejected Him in front of Pilate, saying that He was guilty of sin.
verses.14: But you have denied the holy and just man, and treated him as an enemy.
verses.15: And you rejected the leader of life, whom God raised from the dead. We are witnesses to this.
verses.16: And on the basis of his name, you may consider and know that his name was changed. And through him, faith gave him this blessing, which he received from all of you.
verses.17: And now, brothers, I know that you have acted in ignorance, just as your rulers have done.
verses.18: And the God who had foretold through the mouths of all the prophets that Christ would suffer, has fulfilled this prediction in such a way.
verses.19: So, you have repented and returned to your sins, which were forgiven.
verses.20: So that we may go out during the times of warming weather from the face of the Lord. And let him send to you the one who is in charge of you, Jesus Christ.
verses.21: It must be left in the hands of heaven until the time comes for its restoration. All that God has spoken through the mouths of the holy prophets since the days of those prophets.
verses.22: Moses said that a chief priest of God will rise up from among your brothers, just like me. You should listen to everything he says to you.
verses.23: And every soul that does not listen to the prophet’s words will be torn out of the people.
verses.24: And all those prophets, from Samuel onward, who have spoken and criticized these days.
verses.25: You are the children of the prophets and of the covenant that God made with your fathers, saying to Abraham: “All the nations of the earth will be blessed through your descendants.”
verses.26: First, the God raised up his son to send him to you, so that he could exult over you as each of you was freed from the evils that plagued you.
